items.title: IPC single-instance enforcement
items.text: CLI commands no longer silently spawn a second window manager when the main process's socket is unreachable. Instead, a sentinel file signals the running instance to rebind its socket, with automatic retry and backoff. If the server truly isn't running, it fails fast (~900ms) instead of hanging.

items.title: Stability fix
items.text: Added a thundering-herd guard to prevent multiple CLI processes from triggering simultaneous socket resets, and ensured the sentinel file is only cleaned up after a successful rebind.
